title: Mock stubs
description: Per-test overrides registered at runtime. An event stub answers a domain event with another event; an HTTP stub intercepts a request. Each is consumed by the first thing it matches.

on.description: The CloudEvents type of the event to answer.

match.description: Dot paths into the triggering event's envelope, each with the value it must equal. Omitted or empty matches any event of that type.

response.description: The event to emit when this stub matches. Omit for scheduling.timer.requested, which emits the callback the timer request carries.

data.description: Merged over the triggering event's data. Time tokens are resolved.

url.description: The request path to match exactly. With domain, relative to it.

domain.description: Prefix for url: the path matched is /<domain><url>.

method.description: Matched case-insensitively. Omit to match any method.

response.description: What an intercepted request answers. Without one it answers 200 with an empty object. A procedure's create intercepted by this stub is suppressed whatever the response says.
